_comment: Phase 18 mode-switch matcher tuning data — NOT logic. These lists are read at launch by ModeSwitchPatterns.load and consumed by ModeSwitchDetector. They are meant to be tuned by editing this file (cheaper than a rebuild of the detection logic); the matching rules (cue + target proximity, opposite-mode-only, edge weighting) live in code. All entries are lowercase; matching lowercases the transcript first. Phrases may be multi-word. Keep targets specific enough that a bare format-noun never carries a match on its own — the detector additionally REQUIRES a switch cue nearby, but loose targets still widen the surface.
